title: Ashlar masonry in coursed or broken bond
purpose: Generate tileable PBR maps of dressed stone ashlar: coursed rows of varying height or broken ashlar with blocks one or two rows high, thin joints, and faces rubbed smooth, rock-faced inside a drafted margin or bush-hammered, in limestone, granite or sandstone. Use for walls, plinths, facades and castles.

contract.signature: generate(width=256, height=256, seed=0, preset="default", directx_normal=False, **parameters) -> {map name: {"channels", "colour_space", "pixels"}}
contract.command_line: python ashlar_masonry.py --size 1024 --seed 7 --preset NAME --out DIR [--width W --height H] [--set NAME=VALUE] [--directx-normal] [--orm]

parameters.name: layout
parameters.meaning: 0 coursed ashlar (every block one course high, courses of varying height), 1 broken ashlar (blocks one to three equal rows high, joints broken in both directions).

parameters.name: courses
parameters.meaning: Rows of blocks across the tile height.

parameters.name: block_length
parameters.meaning: Mean block length in tile widths; each block varies by about 40 percent.

parameters.name: joint_width
parameters.meaning: Mortar joint width in texture units.

parameters.name: joint_depth
parameters.meaning: How far the mortar sits behind the faces.

parameters.name: face_style
parameters.meaning: 0 rubbed smooth with faint tool lines, 1 drafted margin around a rock-faced centre, 2 bush-hammered stippling.

parameters.name: margin
parameters.meaning: Width of the drafted margin around rock-faced centres, in texture units.

parameters.name: relief
parameters.meaning: How far rock-faced centres stand proud and how rough they are.

parameters.name: tooling
parameters.meaning: Depth of chisel lines on margins and smooth faces.

parameters.name: hue_shift
parameters.meaning: Hue rotation of the albedo in turns.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Cream limestone in coursed ashlar, rubbed faces and thin joints.

presets.name: rockfaced_granite
presets.description: Grey granite in broken ashlar with drafted margins and rock-faced centres.

presets.name: sandstone_tooled
presets.description: Warm sandstone courses with chiselled faces and bedding streaks.

presets.name: bush_hammered
presets.description: Pale limestone broken ashlar with stippled bush-hammered faces.

limits: Blocks are rectangles on a 32-column grid, so block ends fall on multiples of 1/32 of the tile width; broken ashlar mixes one- and two-row blocks only. Tool lines, rock faces, stippling and weathering are noise and wave approximations, not carved geometry. Mineral speckle is a per-pixel pick, so it shimmers at small sizes. Occlusion is a blurred-height estimate, not ray traced.
technique_references: Greedy block packing on a toroidal grid with random lengths that sum to the tile width
Row pairs split into tall blocks or independently jointed stacks for broken ashlar
Rectangle side distances for joints and arrises
Drafted margin and rock-faced centre from distance to the block edge
Fractional Brownian motion of tileable gradient noise
Height to tangent-space normal by central differences
